name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
description: Native text-only Research decoder for the 1017 update, with checkpoint-specific grouped attention activation quantization, packed experts and bounded safetensors reads. Source: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
limitations: Experimental native text implementation. Full-checkpoint inference, quality, performance, parser, agent and endurance gates for 1017 remain unverified. No performance evidence transfers from earlier V4 or V4.1 checkpoints.
Eager TP=1, one request and 2048 total tokens with a naive cache and no prefix reuse. Vision is not implemented. DSpark is unvalidated for 1017 and disabled in this recipe.

Reads original safetensors directly. The model owns a dedicated packed expert LRU; the fused engine setting avoids generic MoE bank allocation. Generic FTW conversion and offload-cache controls do not apply.
The 96 GiB runtime budget reuses the earlier V4.1 cache allocation for identical model geometry; it has not been measured on 1017 and is not a certification result.
Requires roughly 510 GB of local storage. Engram tables are read by row and never loaded whole. First-token and decode latency may be high.
